summary: Frontend-only verification of the new merged 'Inline Action Stream' post-recording flow (PostRecordingFlow.js) in MeetingReport.js. Tested via Playwright with cookie-injected manager + attendee sessions against the public preview URL, using seed_pii_flow.py to drive meeting.status/pii_review_status. All 10 requested scenarios plus regressions A-D from iteration_67 verified as PASSING. Only minor cosmetic/copy/contrast issues found; no functional breakage.

ui_bugs.issue: When meeting.pii_review_status is already 'reviewed' but status is back at 'processing'/'transcribing' (e.g. Retry Processing / re-upload of a meeting whose PII was previously reviewed), step 3 'Confidentiality Check' renders as green 'Complete' out of order while steps 2 and 4 are still Waiting. Consider gating step3 'done' on step2Done as well.
'Complete' right-hand label wraps onto a second line beneath the title for step 1 only (step 2 stays right-aligned) — inconsistent row heights on mobile.

integration_issues.flow: Apply/Skip -> full report transition (delayed-PII case where analysis already exists)
integration_issues.issue: After clicking Skip/Apply the flow stays on screen for ~5-7s showing all 4 steps green + the 'Processing your recording' spinner before the tabbed report renders (awaits fetchMeeting + transcript-text fetch). Functionally correct, but the lingering spinner reads as a stall. Consider an optimistic switch once pii completion returns 200.

issues: 'Waiting' status labels and waiting-step titles use text-gray-300/text-gray-400 on a gray-50 background (~1.5-2.5:1) — fails WCAG AA; the attendee's 'Pending manager review' label is almost illegible (see attendee/analyzing state).

Step 4 shimmer copy 'Continues in the background — you can complete the confidentiality check above while this finishes' is shown unconditionally: it still displays after the confidentiality check is Complete, and to attendees who cannot perform the check at all.

action_items: Optional: gate step-3 'done' state on step2Done so it cannot show Complete before transcription in the retry/re-process case.
Optional: make step-4 shimmer copy conditional (only while step3 is active for manager/admin).
Optional: raise contrast of 'Waiting'/'Pending manager review' labels (text-gray-300 -> gray-500).
Optional: reduce the ~5s post-skip/apply spinner lag before the tabbed report renders.
critical_code_review_comments: PostRecordingFlow.js scan effect keys off scanStartedRef only — if the scan request fails it never retries (scanError copy says 'Scan could not complete — you can still proceed', shown inside a 'No issues found' card which is slightly misleading wording for an error state).
MeetingReport.js showPostRecordingFlow logic verified: no duplicate stepper remains, processing_failed branch correctly excluded from the merged flow.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_PII meetings via /app/backend/tests/seed_pii_flow.py create (one driven through processing/transcribing/analyzing/in_review/processing_failed, one forced to status='stopped' with transcript_id=NULL for the not-yet-processed CTA). All TEST_PII meetings deleted afterwards via `seed_pii_flow.py cleanup` (deleted 8).
